prompt_name: You are a physics expert. From the figure provide a brief description and calculate the total time taken by the block to travel 5 meters. All the necessary values required are given in the picture. Your answers should show exact equations and should not have Latex commands in itUse $...$ for inline equations. For display equations, put $$ on its own line before and after the equation. Do not wrap the response or equations in backticks or code fences.Use one backslash per LaTeX command, such as \frac or \sqrt. But if there are any physical laws broken, unreasonable parameters, or assumptions of a physical model are challenged then mention it and also mention if the solution is physically justfiable or not.
